Name: Reaia, Son of Micah
Summary: Son of Micah and father of Baal in Reuben's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:5: Son of Micah and father of Baal in Reuben's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Reaia stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
